text_block_list.text:
One day, I was discussing training plans 
with Hishi Amazon, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
choice_data_list: You look down. Something on your mind?
You look down. Something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Sharp as ever, Trainy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Actually, the dorm folks are holding a 
test of courage, so they asked me to make 
a 'ghost' costume.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad you appreciate my sewing skills, 
but, well—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's research for designing 
costumes, having to watch horror movies 
really bums me out...
choice_data_list: So you're no good with horror, huh?
You're not good with horror, are you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I-It can't be helped, alright!? Even big 
sis Hishi Ama has her weaknesses!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Earthquakes, thunder, fires, scary 
dads—I'll take 'em all on 1-on-1! But... 
ghosts are where I draw the line~!!
choice_data_list: ……Want me to watch it with you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: A-Are you sure? That really helps, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If I get spooked and miss what the ghost 
looks like, I won't be able to use it for 
costume making, you know?

And... simulating the real test of 
courage, I turned off the lights in the 
Trainer's Room and started watching a 
horror movie with Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, Train-nerd... when the heck is that 
ghost actually gonna show up?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If you keep me terrified like this the 
whole time, even my steel heart won't be 
able to take it...!
choice_data_list: That's just how horror is...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Guh... Pulling cheap tricks like that. 
Come at me fair and square—

text_block_list.name: Movie Ghost
text_block_list.text: "—Woooaaaagh!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Uhyaaaaah!?
choice_data_list: Th-there it is!!

text_block_list.name: Ghost's Victim
text_block_list.text: "Guaaaahhh...!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
O-Our attacks did nothing, and people got 
wiped out just like that...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Stop it, Trainy...! I know it's for 
making the costume, but I can't watch this 
anymore!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If it's a ghost, I can't even lay a hand 
on it—how am I supposed to throw down 
one-on-one?!

Hishi Amazon ended up getting cold feet... 
At this rate, reference materials for the 
costume are out of the question. The way 
to solve this is—
choice_data_list:
So I just need to challenge them to a 
one-on-one, right?
You wanna go one-on-one, huh?
Leave the rest to me.
Leave the rest to me.

text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon ended up getting cold feet... 
At this rate, reference materials for the 
costume are out of the question. The way 
to solve this is—
choice_data_list:
So I just need to challenge them to a 
one-on-one, right?
You wanna go one-on-one, huh?
Leave the rest to me.
Leave the rest to me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah. If punches and kicks worked, 
there's no way I'd ever lose!

In that case, I suggested switching to a 
horror movie where physical attacks 
actually work on the monster.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see... That's a great idea! Throw some 
candidates my way, Trainy!
choice_data_list:
First, a remake of the movie we're 
watching now.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
T-That's basically the same thing! Gimme 
something else, anything else!
choice_data_list:
Then, an action movie set in a 
post-apocalyptic world.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, those attacks sure look 
effective, but now the opponent's turned 
into a punk instead of a ghost!?"
choice_data_list: —A movie depicting "The Mummy"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! That way we can take 'em on 
one-on-one, and it's just the right amount 
of spooky!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We should've just gone with that from the 
start. You're pretty sharp, Trainer-dude!

Saying "You're welcome," I showed Hishi 
Amazon the cover of *Thrilling!! Umamusume 
vs. The Mummy*.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What's with this mummy on the package? 
Those bandages are wrapped awfully 
sloppily.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
In the outfits I make, I gotta pump up the 
spirit just like a tight, crisp sarashi 
wrap!

...Critiques of the mummy costume aside, 
it seems Hishi Amazon is back to her usual 
self.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...! You're telling me to leave 
Trainy behind and run away with my tail 
between my legs?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
N-No way in hell! I'd rather do anything 
else than—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to conquer my fear of ghosts! 
I'll show 'em what true grit looks like!
choice_data_list: ...Don't go overdoing it, alright?

...Make sure not to push yourself too 
hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah. Of course.
choice_data_list:
Are you okay with the volume and lighting 
as they are?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No problem! It's the same for you too, 
Trainy, after all!
choice_data_list: Do you need something to drink?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Hrm. N-No, I'll pass...

And so, I ended up watching the horror 
movie to the very end together with Hishi 
Amazon, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: F-Fufufu...! Trainer-dono...!!
(*Wooooo-whoops!*)
choice_data_list: Hishi Amazon!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: M-My legs... gave out on meee...

Overcoming your weaknesses is hard... That 
was something Hishi Amazon experienced 
firsthand.
